Research before investing

No universal best investment. Compare historical price changes, volatility and drawdowns, then test a forecast against an unchanged-price baseline.

Where can I research investing?

Cash/deposits: check access and protection. Diversified funds/ETFs: check holdings, costs and capital risk. Bonds: check credit and duration risk. Individual shares: check the business and concentration risk.

MoneyHelper: saving or investing ↗

Upload licensed daily price history with exactly date,symbol,price,currency. At least 240 shared dates, one quote currency, max 10 symbols and 2 MiB. Check adjusted prices and units; dividends, taxes and costs are not included.

The example is an attributed historical ECB currency-reference snapshot, not stock/ETF prices or live trading quotes. No buy/sell recommendation.
